card.name: The start of "debilitated" in patient lists
card.fires_on: The first piece of "debilitated" ("deb" or "Deb") after "elderly," or "cachectic, or" in lists of patient groups. It also fires on "noticeable" in "no noticeable impact".

modes.label: Debilitated patients
modes.description: The opening piece of "debilitated" in lists of frail patient groups such as elderly or cachectic.
modes.example: Elderly, cachectic, or<< deb>>ilitated patients may have altered pharmacokin

modes.label: No noticeable impact
modes.description: The word "noticeable" right before "impact" in a general technical sentence.
modes.example: hardware-level encryption usually has no<< noticeable>> impact on performance.

card.writes: It promotes "influence" words and suppresses "affect" words, which suggests it pushes toward words that fit before "impact" or "effect" style terms.
card.plain: It lights up on the start of the word "debilitated" when frail patients are listed, such as elderly or cachectic ones.
